data.name: Kameel
data.gender_notes: Kameel is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is perfect in form and action. The name Kameel carries the meaning “Perfect” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Kameel usually hope their child will grow to embody perfect and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner and outer beauty, and the pursuit of spiritual perfection
data.etymology: Kameel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Perfect.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kameel total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: كامل
in_arabic.meaning: الكامل في الصفات الحميدة والخصال الجميلة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم كامل مشتق من الجذر العربي ك-م-ل، ويعني الشخص الذي يتصف بالكمال في جميع الصفات الحميدة والخصال الجميلة، وقد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران الآية 138، ويحمل هذا الاسم دلالات روحية عميقة تتعلق بالسعي نحو الكمال والتمام في جميع جوانب الحياة

in_urdu.name: کامیل
in_urdu.meaning: جو تمام خوبیوں اور خوب صفات کا مالک ہو
in_urdu.long_meaning: کامیل نام عربی جڑ ک-م-ل سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو تمام خوب صفات اور خصال کا حامل ہو، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان خاص طور پر مقبول ہے، اور اسلامی روایت میں اس کی روحانی اہمیت گہری ہے

in_hindi.name: कामिल
in_hindi.meaning: जो सभी अच्छी विशेषताओं और गुणों का मालिक हो
in_hindi.long_meaning: कामिल नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल क-م-ल से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो सभी अच्छी विशेषताओं और गुणों का मालिक हो, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी लोकप्रिय है, जहां यह नाम धार्मिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्व रखता है

in_pashto.name: کامل
in_pashto.meaning: چې د ټولو ښو صفاتو او ځانګړتیاو خاوند دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: کامل نوم د عربي ريښې ک-م-ل څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د ټولو ښو صفاتو او ځانګړتیاو خاوند دی، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې مهم دی، او د اسلامي ارزښتونو سره تړاو لري

in_english.name: Kameel
in_english.meaning: Perfect, complete, having all good qualities and attributes
in_english.long_meaning: The name Kameel originates from the Arabic root k-m-l, signifying someone who embodies perfection and completeness in all good qualities and attributes, referenced in the Quran (Quran 3:138), carries deep spiritual connotations related to striving for perfection and completeness in all aspects of life

data.cultural_impact: The name Kameel carries a sense of admiration and respect, as it signifies a person who embodies excellence and perfection in their actions and endeavors. This name can be a source of inspiration for individuals striving to better themselves and reach their full potential.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Kameel holds deep significance as it reflects the ultimate strive for an individually authentic relationship with the Divine Creator. The name represents the quiet and effective pursuit of transcendence and spiritual growth, and echoes the Prophetic Hadith, "Verily, Allah loves those who are constant in pursuit of what they love." (Bukhari and Muslim). Through its association with the ideal of perfection, the name serves as a reminder of the divine potential lying within each person, and the imperative to continually strive towards connection with the transcendent.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Perfect" symbolizes One who is perfect in form and action. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Kameel serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of perfect.
